name: Module Support Frame
description: A space frame that supports modules and transfers their loads to the jacket/tower substructure; may also house storage tanks, pig launchers/receivers, metering devices and piping. Provides the structural skeleton for integrated or modular decks.

specifications.metric: truss vs portal frame longitudinal rows
specifications.basis: 20-25 m wide deck: trusses at centreline and both outer walls; portal frames in 2 rows ~14-16 m apart
allowing floor cantilevers of approximately 5 m

specifications.metric: conventional steel floor share of deck steel weight
specifications.basis: conventional steel floor contributes about half the steel structure weight of an offshore deck
high strength steel commonly used at present; trend to 420-460 MPa

specifications.value: floor plate 1 m; stringer 5 m; deck beam 15 m; main structure 15 m

applications: A space frame that supports modules and transfers their loads to the jacket/tower substructure; may also house storage tanks, pig launchers/receivers, metering
